'''Lianna Docking Bay 5630''' was located in [[Lola Curich Starport]]. The [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] that transported [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Rodin Hlian Verpalion]] to [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] was berthed in the bay.
